dea-ini-025.text: A pipeline needs to be automatically fired every day at 02h. Which service schedules this execution in the cron style, in a serverless way?
dea-ini-025.explanation: A) Incorrect: SNS publish notifications, not agenda.: DataSync has its own schedule only for the SUAS transfer tasks.: Athena executes consultations, not schedule pipelines. D) Correct: the EventBridge Scheduler (or cron rules of the EventBridge) shoot targets like Step Functions, Glue and Lambda at defined times.

dea-ini-026.text: What the AWS Glue Data Quality allows you to do in a data pipeline?
options: Define and evaluate REGRAS quality (e.g. completeness, uniqueness, values within range) on datasets, failing data outside the default
dea-ini-026.explanation: (a) Correct: or Glue Data Quality uses rules (DQDL) as ColumnCount, IsComplete and Uniqueness to measure and block bad data before they follow in the pipeline. B) Incorrect: encryption is KMS/S3. C) Incorrect: format conversion is job paper ETL. D) Incorrect: dashboards are QuickSight.

dea-ini-027.text: Like the Amazon Athena collects for the consultations, and what is the practical implication of this for the data teams?
options: By TB of data ESCANEADOS by query; the implication is to optimize format, compression and partitioning to scan less
By cluster hour on; the implication is to turn off the cluster at night
dea-ini-027.explanation: A) Correct: the collection is by scanned data — so compressed parquet + partitions + SELECT of specific columns directly reduce the invoice. B) Incorrect: users are not the collection metric. C) Incorrect: there is no unlimited signature. D) Incorrect: there is no cluster in the Athena.

dea-ini-028.text: A team wants to follow if a stream of Kinesis is with consumers who are late in writing (lag). CloudWatch indicates this delay?
dea-ini-028.explanation: A) Incorrect: CPU is a metric of instances, not of stream lag. B) Correct: IteratorAge measures how "old" are the records that the consumer is reading — rising, consumers are not accompanying the intake. C) Incorrect: BucketSizeBytes is the S3. D) Incorrect: FreeStorageSpace is of banks RDS.

dea-ini-029.text: A company needs to encrypt data from the lake in S3 at rest, with managed keys whose uses are recorded for audit.?
options: Save keys to a file in the pocket itself
SSE-KMS with a customer managed key (use of the audited key in CloudTrail)
Encryption only in transit with HTTPS
dea-ini-029.explanation: A) Incorrect: violates the basic requirement. B) Incorrect: keep key next to the data nullifies the protection. C) Correct: SSE-KMS cryptograph at rest and each use of the CMK appears in CloudTrail — the audit requirement.: HTTPS protects traffic; the requirement is rest.

dea-ini-030.text: What is the service of AWS centralizes the permissions of a data lake, allowing access by bank, table and even COLUNA for different teams, integrated in the Athena, Glue and Redshift Spectrum?
dea-ini-030.explanation: A) Incorrect: Macie DESCOBRE sensitive data, does not manage permissions. IAM the permissions are at the level of bucket/object — no granularity of table/column. C) Correct: the Lake Formation adds the layer of lake governance: fine permissions (database/table/column/line) respected by the integrated engines. D) Incorrect: Firewall Manager manages firewall rules.

dea-ini-031.text: The compliance area wants to automatically find out if there are sensitive data (CPFs, cards, emails) spread by the newsletters S3 What service does this discovery with machine learning??
dea-ini-031.explanation: (a) Correct: or Macie varsity S3 and classifies sensitive data/PII with ML, generating findings. B) Incorrect: Shield is DDoS protection. C) Incorrect: GuardDuty detects MEASURES by log analysis. D) Incorrect: Inspector evaluate vulnerabilities in workloads (EC2/ECR/Lambda).

dea-ini-032.text: A job from AWS Glue you need to read a pocket S3 and write in another. What is the correct way to grant these permissions to the job?
options: Share the console password with the job
Put user key accesses IAM in the job code
Attribute to the job one IAM Role with reading/writing policies in the required bucks
dea-ini-032.explanation: A) Incorrect: console passwords do not apply to services. 1 D) Correct: Glue takes on a role service — temporary, auditable and minimal scope permissions in job resources.

dea-ini-033.text: A job of ETL connects to a PostgreSQL database and today the password is written in the script. Which service should store this credentials, with encryption and possibility of automatic rotation?
options: A variable in the source code versioned in Git
A tag in the bank's resource
dea-ini-033.explanation: A) Incorrect: Bucket file is not secret safe. B) Incorrect: secret in Git repository is leaking waiting to happen. C) Correct: the Secrets Manager saves encrypted credentials, controls access by IAM and rotates automatically (native integration with RDS). D) Incorrect: tags are public metadata to the console — never for secrets.

dea-ini-034.text: What's the use of Amazon S3 help to ensure, at the level of CONTA or the bucket, that no data from the lake is publicly exposed by mistake?
dea-ini-034.explanation: A) Incorrect: Inventory lists objects for audit, does not block access. B) Incorrect: versioning protects against overwriting/exclusion, not against public exposure. C) Correct: Block Public Access blocks ACLs and public policies, even if someone sets them up by mistake — data lake essential guardrail. D) Incorrect: Intelligent-Tiering is cost optimization.

dea-ini-035.text: Which ones DUAS practices directly reduce the cost and time of analytical consultations on a data lake in S3? (Select DUAS alternatives)
options: Partition data by columns used in filters (e.g. date))
Store data in compressed columnal format (Parquet)/ORC)
Use only files CSV without compression
Concentrate all data into a single giant file of 5 TB
dea-ini-035.explanation: A) Correct: partition pruning makes the engine read only the filter folders. B) Correct: columnar + compression = less bytes scanned by query. C) Incorrect: CSV without compression maximizes scanning. D) Incorrect: without catalog, Athena/Spectrum can't even consult in an organized way. E) Incorrect: a single giant archive prevents parallelism and selective reading.

dea-ini-036.text: Which ones DUAS statements on the Amazon Kinesis Is Data Firehose correct? (Select DUAS alternatives)
options: Delivers data with guaranteed latency of 1 millisecond
Retains data by up to 365 days for rereading
Demands that you write a consumer application with the KCL
You can convert the records to Apache Parquet before delivering to S3
It is fully managed: there are no shards to manage or consumers to develop
dea-ini-036.explanation: A) Incorrect: Firehose is near real-time (typical buffer of 60S+), not milliseconds. B) Incorrect: long retention/replay is characteristic of Data Streams; Firehose delivers and follows (second/minute buffer). C) Incorrect: KCL is for consumers of Kinesis Date STREAMS. D) Correct: native conversion to Parquet/ORC (with a pattern of Glue Catalog) is one of the most charged resources. E) Correct: Firehose is delivery service — scale and consumption are managed by AWS.
